`class WebpResourceAnimationReader`<br/>
**Implements:** [`IResourceAnimationReader`](/reference/resources/iresourceanimationreader/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.resource.animation.impl` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [WebpResourceAnimationReader.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/resource/animation/impl/WebpResourceAnimationReader.java)

Reads the frames of an animated WebP.

## Description

A frame duration of 10 ms or less shows for 100 ms.

## Method details

<a id="WebpResourceAnimationReader-method-read"></a>

### read

`ResourceAnimation read(InputStream stream)` 

**Throws:**

- `IllegalArgumentException`: The file does not start with a RIFF WEBP header, it is not a WebP image: check the file and its extension
- `IllegalArgumentException`: The WebP chunk … runs past the end of the file, the file is damaged: export it again
- `IllegalArgumentException`: The WebP has no ANMF frame or no VP8X size, it is not an animated WebP: draw it as a still image or export it with its animation

Reads every frame of the WebP, composed with its blend and disposal, and its play count.
Throws `IllegalArgumentException` when the file is not a WebP, has no animation frame, or holds a chunk that runs past its end.

<a id="WebpResourceAnimationReader-method-isWebp"></a>

### isWebp

`boolean isWebp(byte[] bytes)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

If `true`, `bytes` start with a RIFF header of type `WEBP`.

<a id="WebpResourceAnimationReader-method-isAnimated"></a>

### isAnimated

`boolean isAnimated(byte[] bytes)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

If `true`, `bytes` are a WebP whose extended header has the animation flag.
